change: Fixed a pre-execution keyword mismatch in the calibration/phase-diagram driver; no result artifact was emitted by the failed launch.
reason: The driver passed q= while the truth constructor accepts charge=.

change: After the first calibration, corrected circular-contour and Jacobian detectors to seed from the darkest samples and refine subpixel zeros rather than requiring a sampled local minimum. The failed calibration is preserved.
reason: The first positive-control implementation returned zero for every half/quarter-pixel single vortex because a subpixel zero need not be a discrete local minimum; this was a candidate-selection defect.

change: Corrected the analytical field amplitude to a finite-width core depression times a nonzero envelope; the first amplitude model decayed globally and made subpixel calibration uninterpretable. The phase/topology and charge cases are unchanged.
reason: A positive r^|q| radial factor combined with a narrow core caused the field to underflow away from the center, so darkest-sample contour tests were selecting boundary artifacts.

change: Increased contour/Jacobian candidate deduplication radius from the initial local scale to 1.5 times the contour radius; retained the prior calibration outputs as failed detector-calibration evidence.
reason: The first non-degenerate amplitude field produced multiple accepted records around one subpixel core, inflating location counts and charge.

change: Separated raw winding-cell records from estimated singularity locations/components in the result schema; added explicit charge-mass and top-level false-positive/false-negative/localization fields. Earlier outputs are preserved and are not overwritten.
reason: A raw nonzero plaquette is a representation cell, not automatically one singularity. The revised schema directly tests the EXP-0016 count-definition question.

change: Added the planned 2048? analytical-reference/downsample control, padding/crop controls, and a seeded 96-trial subpixel uncertainty subset; added an independently written result schema for the SciPy replication.
reason: These controls were specified in the EXP-0016 handoff and are needed to distinguish estimator-definition effects from resolution, boundary, and random-shift effects.

change: Corrected the validation script field mapping for independent absolute/signed charge comparisons; the first validation run failed closed on a validator bug, not on a result discrepancy.
reason: The independent artifact names charge fields abs/signed while the main schema names them absolute_charge/signed_charge.

change: Added the preregistered localization_error alias alongside localization_error_px in the common result schema.
reason: The frozen observable list names localization_error; the unit-explicit alias preserves that field name without discarding the pixel unit.

change: Added an explicit finite-field boundary-crossing control with left/right/top/bottom/lower-left translations, q=+1/+2, exact-on-edge offsets, and a 16-pixel padded-field/crop comparison.
reason: Boundary crossings were part of the EXP-0016 handoff and must be separated from ordinary resolution and candidate-selection failures.

change: Expanded the boundary-crossing control to record the full padded-field detector result as well as the cropped result, so a boundary loss can be separated from a detector ROI convention.
reason: The first boundary output compared only unpadded and cropped fields; the full padded field is needed to show whether the missing feature is recoverable before cropping.

change: Added a post-completion bird?s-eye error visualization and machine-readable hotspot list using only frozen EXP-0016 result rows.
reason: The user requested a bird?s-eye view of error spots. No estimator, threshold, result row, or physical interpretation was changed.
